# Trusted responsive raster assets — additive Theme API1 capability

Dusk1.3.0 declares artwork_styles:[editorial,none] and signed PNG/WebP variants. Older packages without this field remain valid; older verifiers reject new WebP/options rather than silently discard settings. Maximum28asset entries/48physical files; aggregate2MiB, per-asset1MiB, image1024px per side, template64KiB and production smoke6CPU/768MiB/64KiB/10wall remain bounded. CSS still forbids remote URLs/imports/scripts; the existing CSS guard was not relaxed.

A core `theme_asset_url(name)` resolves only the current immutable bundle asset map. `theme_picture(name,loading:,sizes:)` produces local signed-digest srcset360/768/1024 with PNGfallback, explicit dimensions and decorative alt. Core guard permits picture/source only with appropriate context/type; srcset candidates must be exact WebP entries in the same bundle, ascending unique allowed width descriptors and bounded length/count. Remote/data/protocol-relative/admin/unrelated candidates, malformed descriptors and unsupported sizes fail closed. No arbitrary HTML/CSS/script override, endpoint authority, SEO head or upload MIME expansion follows.

ThemeWebp accepts only a simple opaque single-frame RIFF/VP8 container, exact size/chunk/padding, frame header and <=1024dimensions. Animation, VP8X/metadata/unknown chunks/trailers and malformed streams fail closed. It additionally requires actual native full decode by operator-configured dwebp1.6.0or newer1.x. User media upload remains on its existing PNG/JPEG policy. PNGstill uses existing structural/inflate validation and native production smoke.

Operator prerequisite: install a supported native dwebp utility from the [official WebP distribution](https://developers.google.com/speed/webp/download), retain its license/provenance and configure the absolute canonical executable path in host-owned RAILPRESS_WEBP_DECODER. It must be a regular executable owned by root/current operator and not group/world writable. Source/runtime package does not bundle a helper binary or private path. The local qualified utility was official Linuxx86-64libwebp1.6.0; do not infer other-host qualification or global CVE clearance. No sudo/system install is required by the application itself.

Decode subprocesses scrub credentials/environment, use4CPU/768MiB/64KiBlog/5wall bounds, private temp input/logs and /dev/null pixels, and inherit the bounded caller process group. Timeout kills the exact decoder PID. Production theme smoke uses VIPS_CONCURRENCY=1 under its unchanged limits. A bounded content-hash plus decoder-file-identity cache stores validation booleans only, never site/actor/preview/overlay/render state. Every load still verifies signed bytes before cache use. Missing/unsafe/outdated/failing decoder prevents staging; damaged active package uses existing safe core emergency/recovery behavior.

Artwork_style is nonsensitive immutable overlay data, Owner-only with existing preview receipt/activation/revision locking. New installs defaulteditorial; retained old Dusk snapshots lacking a choice defaultnone. Portabilityformat2 explicitly carries the enum; unsupported destinations reject it instead of dropping it or silently activating. A04asset retrieval/preview/cache/security tests and both-engine regressions are the qualification authority.

Native host configuration may retain the optional decoder path as host-owned environment. No actual application release/revert was thereby qualified: exact old/new core/theme/decoder compatibility, stable installation paths and independent-time native admission must pass the existing A03/A08/A09gates. A browser PNGfallback does not bypass failed server package verification.
